page.overview:
Who is Arkham Detective?

The Arkham Detective is a fictional character created by American author and filmmaker Byron Craft for his eponymous series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. The Detective, whose name is never revealed, made his debut appearance in the 2015 novella Cthulhu's Minions.

A hard-boiled detective in the employ of the Prohibition-era Arkham Police Department, the Detective spends his time working for the department's Mythos Division, a subdivision of that agency dedicated to combatting the many and varied supernatural threats which plague the small New England city of Arkham. Despite his lack of jurisdiction outside of his home town, he has been known to travel to other notable Lovecraft Country locations, including Innsmouth and Dunwich. He has been stated to have lost two different partners in the twelve months leading up to the first story.

The Detective was once married with a son but, due to the long hours he spent on the job and with his drinking buddies in the town's many Speakeasies, his wife left him, taking the child with her. He has not spoken to either of them since.

During one of his investigations, a murder-kidnapping which took him to the coastal town of Innsmouth by the sea, the Detective rescued a seven-year-old girl named Allison. The terrors they experienced that night created a strong bond between the two, and he soon adopted the girl. While he is at work his landlady, an elderly, good-natured woman by the name of Mrs. Trumble, takes care of Allison, and has even gone so far as to convert her spare room into a play area for her.
